conversionNotes: Modern d0–3 are player notes; d4–7 are opponent notes.
Camera FocusCamera events establish classic mustHitSection for each section; absolute note times and lengths are untouched.
The current nine Week1 metadata files have a single BPM each; converter also splits sections at future tempo changes.
Events and optional note kinds remain embedded in converted charts. Existing browser engine may ignore camera/animation events.
Vocals combine original player and dad stems sample-aligned; negative voice offset advances by trimming, positive delays with zero padding.
Only merged vocals are Vorbis re-encoded; instrumentals retain original bytes.
